value.rationale: Precisely classifies every possible empirical-measure cluster of a dense orbit with two fixed top Cantor–Bendixson points, and realizes every member of the classification on one fixed homeomorphism type with the same stationary simplex. This sharply separates topological complexity, invariant measures, and generic versus historic statistics. Nontrivial cases include prescribed interior singleton mixtures and the full simplex, not just an endpoint counterexample.
